title: [Lean] Certify complete selected companion prefix footprints and cuts
body:
## Result

At source-matched κ = 836330098538459/500000000000000000 = 0.001672660197076918, this Lean certificate accounts for both selected 16,508-mark prefixes, all six phases, exactly 23 tracked companion label writes, and all 23 move/seven ADD-query arithmetic cuts. It proves finite mark/label footprints and conditional projected cursor facts, retaining the explicit L508 start2/terminal999 hypotheses. JSON-byte-to-typed-mark correspondence, successful full guarded lowering, RecipesExact, full-phase operator equality, physical execution and cost remain explicit gaps; it does not change κ or prove the full multiplication theorem.

The finite certificate accounts for both raw prefixes [0,16508), not merely their projected 23 moves. Every omitted mark is accounted for by the label-write/phase footprint, with the complete COPY destination using its dynamic stored tag. The checked arithmetic joins all 23 move cuts, seven ADD-query cuts and prior-write counts to the accepted projected source tables. These are label/cursor facts, not deletion of physical operations.

## Checked closure and reproduction

The exact final source 625a27a8/object 82232134 has independent terminal 3fbe6bb2. The accepted closure includes 66 finite block certificates, one core and one exhaustive join, plus nine retained research prerequisites. The 68 newly checked roots produced 727 complete probes in 141.875897878 seconds of compiler time. Only accepted block 58 retains two known style warnings. Original monolith timeout and namespace/reflexivity/append-association failures are preserved; they were not hidden by changing accepted claims.

This PR includes 75 exact accepted Lean sources (628,374 bytes), fetching only unchanged Stream and HyperplaneEnd.Labels from immutable public 0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea. The full 77-module closure is pinned. The materializer preserves the dotted HyperplaneEnd/Labels.lean layout and all existing imports; the README supplies public fetch and topological build commands for Lean 4.21.0/Mathlib 308445d7. No physical Hosting package is assumed to supply unpublished helper prerequisites.

## Credit, scope and CI

Credit icekylinx's selected emitter, DreamingOfClouds' LemmaG semantics, Jeremy Kothe's HyperplaneEnd labels, Hanson Sun's PR1611 helper450 binding lead and Lean/Mathlib contributors. Original source headers and Apache-2.0 provenance are retained; new work used OpenAI assistance.

Current all-state exact-module and proposed-branch searches found no matching PR. Related historical prefix audits concern different source instances/interfaces; this is bounded overlap screening. In particular, the L508 start2/terminal999 hypotheses, JSON-to-typed instruction correspondence, successful whole-word lowering and physical/operator suppliers are not silently discharged.

No extra compiler or CI pre-review was run for packaging. Candidate CI will be checked after submission; generic repository checks alone do not establish a Lean replay. Historical source-preparation comments stay byte-identical, with current acceptance recorded separately.
